# How much can you put in your SEP-IRA in 2026?

> Free calculator for the 2026 SEP-IRA contribution limit for a sole proprietor or single-member LLC — 20% of net self-employment earnings (the self-employed equivalent of the 25% plan rate), capped at $72,000, with a Solo 401(k) comparison. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
